segments.sn11.12:1.3: “sakko, bhikkhave, devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno magho nāma māṇavo ahosi, tasmā maghavāti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:2.1: “Sakko, bhikkhave, devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno pure [pure pure (sī. pī.)] dānaṃ adāsi, tasmā purindadoti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:3.1: “Sakko, bhikkhave, devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ adāsi, tasmā sakkoti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:4.1: “Sakko, bhikkhave, devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno āvasathaṃ adāsi, tasmā vāsavoti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:5.1: “Sakko, bhikkhave, devānamindo sahassampi atthānaṃ muhuttena cinteti, tasmā sahassakkhoti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:6.1: “Sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānamindassa sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpati, tasmā sujampatīti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:7.1: “Sakko, bhikkhave, devānamindo devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti, tasmā devānamindoti vuccati.
segments.sn11.12:8.1: “Sakkassa, bhikkhave devānamindassa pubbe manussabhūtassa satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ, yesaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā.
segments.sn11.12:8.7: yāvajīvaṃ vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyaṃ muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato,
segments.sn11.12:8.9: yāvajīvaṃ akkodhano assaṃ – sacepi me kodho uppajjeyya, khippameva naṃ paṭivineyyan”ti.
segments.sn11.12:8.10: “Sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānamindassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ, yesaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā”ti.

lines: Āvasathaṃ adāsīti catumahāpathe mahājanassa āvasathaṃ kāretvā adāsi.
Sahassampi atthānanti sahassampi kāraṇānaṃ, janasahassena vā vacanasahassena vā osārite “ayaṃ imassa attho, ayaṃ imassa attho”ti ekapade ṭhitova vinicchinati.
Āvasathanti nivāsaṭṭhānaṃ kāretvā adāsi, tasmā vāsaṃ adāsīti vāsavo.
Maghaṃ vuccati dhanaṃ, taṃ pana saddhāsaṅkhātaṃ maghaṃ assa atthīti maghavā.
